name: Kraken Will

abilities.name: Ink Cloud
abilities.effect: A burst of dark ink hides the holder for about 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Jet Dash
abilities.effect: A squid-style jet: a quick dash away or forward in a spray of ink.

acquire.equipPiece: One coral-red sucker-ringed tentacle sleeve on the left forearm (the only equipped piece); ink wisps and coral afterimages on each dodge.

abilities.name: Tentacle Grip
abilities.effect: Tentacles seize up to four foes and crush them in a hold (bosses resist).

abilities.name: Whirlpool Drag
abilities.effect: The kraken dives in place: a whirlpool drags nearby foes toward it, spinning them in ink.

integrate.transformation: Whole body becomes a kraken beastman in coral mantle plate: bulbous mantle-hood head with a beak and glowing cyan eyes, four long tentacles from the back, two suckered clawed arms with an anchor-trident, a tentacle skirt over digitigrade legs and an ink-cloud aura.

equip.weapon: A ship-breaker anchor-trident with a sucker-ringed shaft.
equip.armor: Coral-red mantle plate with a beaked hood-helm and sucker-ringed bracers over a short tentacle skirt.
equip.hair_eyes: Ink-indigo hair hanging like a mantle; glowing cyan eyes.
equip.aura: A swirling ink cloud with cold bubbles.

lore: The Kraken of the northern sea: arms that seize ships, ink that blots the sea and a whirlpool when it dives.
pitch: The Kraken is the colossal cephalopod of Scandinavian myth that drags whole fleets down and makes a whirlpool when it dives. Acquire keeps you human with one suckered tentacle sleeve, lending an ink cloud and a squid-jet dash. Integrate makes you a coral-red squid beastman in mantle plate with a beaked hood, cyan eyes and four back tentacles, a grabber and puller of crowds paid for with cold breathless strain.
untrained: An untrained holder feels cold phantom arms squeezing their ribs and ink-black sickness; breath fails as if underwater and strain climbs on every grip. Canon: a will that is not suppressed or balanced disrupts body and mana core and can eventually kill the holder, so the first Awakening (forced, a spark in the core) is the most dangerous moment and training both cores is the cure.

spirit.echo: A hunched red squid-beastman: bulbous mantle-hood head, glowing cyan eyes, a beak, four long tentacles from the back, suckered clawed arms, a skirt of short tentacles over digitigrade legs.
spirit.look: A coral-red orb ringed by slowly writhing tentacle shapes with a small glowing cyan ink eye in the middle.
